sample.text: All numbers, names and repositories on these boards are sample data. Standalone boards use the shipped Industry theme (theme.css); board 7 uses VS Code's Dark Modern, Light Modern and High Contrast colours. Plan: docs/plans/cost-by-repository-and-project.md §11.

scenarios1.text:
Usage scenarios on this row (plan §12.4, Playwright web-e2e)

S2 · Board 1 · One project over time (step 15.9): week buckets, last 90 days → Tab to the Sep 1 price marker → tooltip shows old and new unit prices and the source → Escape → View as table equals the chart; the week with no priced turns reads "unknown" and is a gap.

S3 · Boards 2a, 2b · Compare (15.9): select two projects → Compare → resize to 640 px → Details → Escape; only priority columns at 640 px, focus returns to Details.

S10 · Board 1 · One answer everywhere (15.13): one project's October total is equal in the Dashboard, GET /api/cost/timeseries and MCP get_project_cost.

scenarios2.text:
Usage scenarios on this row (plan §12.4)

S4 · Board 3 · Inside a project (15.10): Project tab → click Anthropic → its models → August and October; model bars sum to the vendor total, and usage + price + mix add up exactly to the change.

S5 · Board 4 · Bill a month (15.11): October draft → Issue → confirm → export CSV and Markdown → swap in the updated price book → reload; the frozen figures are unchanged, "Differs from issued" shows the exact diff, exports hold no message text, the unknown-cost line is listed, not summed.

S7 · Board 4 · Estimate (15.12): 20 planned days, 12-week history → a p50–p90 range labelled Estimate at today's prices; never one number.

scenarios3.text:
Usage scenarios on this row (plan §12.4)

S1 · Boards 6, 5 · First project (15.11): "no projects" empty state → Create project → assign three repositories with each row's select, keyboard only → Save; the project's total equals its repositories' sum.

S6 · Board 5 · Overlapping projects (15.11): same repository and branch scope in a second project → tie error inline and in the summary, Save disabled; removing one member enables it.

S8 · Boards 6, 5 · Captures with no folder (15.11): mitmproxy only → Unattributed empty state → add a capture rule → those sessions move to the rule's repository.

S9 · Board 7 · VS Code (15.14, wdio in extension-ui): Group by repository → Cost over time tab; group totals and the status bar match the fixture; axe clean in Dark Modern, Light Modern and High Contrast.
